messages.author: Adam Huffman
messages.body:
Hello
I�m trying to build Amber using EasyBuild.

Adam

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Aug 01, 2025, Adam Huffman via AMBER wrote:
>
>I’m trying to build Amber using EasyBuild.
>
>The latest definition there is for version 24.3, and it is expecting the
>previous download archive, i.e. not the new pmemd format.
>
>Is it possible to obtain these older versions?
Please send an email request to dacase1.gmail.com, and I can send you a
pointer.  We could update the web page to provide access to either format,
but I'd prefer to avoid that if only a few people need it.
...thanks...dac
Note to other readers of this thread: there is no change in the codes
involved.  The only change is in folder structure into which the code is
un-tarred.  The older system required that AmberTools and Amber be
downloaded into a common folder structure; in the newer approach, Amber
(basically the pmemd.* codes) can be built separately from AmberTools.
